team_provenance.kind: new handmade roster combinations of familiar regression sets and three weather components
team_provenance.reservation: frozen before inspecting any scored stage1 outcome; later-stage pools have disjoint six-species rosters from each other, prior reservations and regression originals
team_provenance.holdout_limit: Not an independent external set holdout. Species and component sets overlap; role/style labels are design intentions and team viability is unproven. No team paste is used for prior fitting.
team_provenance.comparison_pairing: Within a stage the same pool is reserved jointly for comparisons to original baseline and predecessor; paired schedule controls matchup difficulty. It is fresh relative to prior-stage evaluations, not independent between these paired arms.
team_provenance.rules: all teams validated using pinned local gen9ou TeamValidator before any scored outcomes

stopping_rule.censored_turn_limit: void, never counted as a played draw or silently dropped

promotion_rule: Correctness fixes may be enabled without proven strength. Policy changes remain off unless fresh confirmation supports benefit and reliability; screening alone is inconclusive.
compute: same requested settings except the allocation stage; one native thread; sequential worlds; actual CPU and search time reported

schedule_design.kind: four-game blocks: both simulator-side swaps and both bot/team assignments
schedule_design.outcome_separation: Frozen before any outcome under this revised schedule. Earlier screening outcomes may already exist; this is not a retrospective claim about screening preregistration.
